title: Seminar handouts
passage:
Do we need to print handouts for the seminar?
A. It starts in the main hall. B. No, everyone will receive a digital copy. C. I've already met the speaker.
passageZh:
我們需要印研討會講義嗎？
A. 研討會在主會場開始。
B. 不需要，每個人都會收到電子檔。
C. 我已經見過講者了。
